[size=6][b][color=#FFB74D]🍳 Gifts From Gus[/color][/b][/size]
[i][color=#FFE0B2]Good food. Good company. Good life.[/color][/i]

[size=4][b]📦 About the Mod[/b][/size]

Receive letters and delicious homemade meals from Gus as your friendship grows.

From simple comfort food to full-course dishes, Gus shares what he does best:
taking care of people through food.

[color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color]

[size=4][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

• 🍳 Friendship-based gifts (1–10 hearts) 
• 🍽️ Homemade meals with useful buffs 
• 💌 Warm and immersive letters 
• 📈 Balanced progression 
• 🌍 Full multi-language support 

[color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color]

[size=4][b]💡 Why This Mod?[/b][/size]

Because sometimes all you need is:
• 🍲 a warm meal 
• 🍺 a quiet evening at the saloon 
• 🤝 someone who cares 

And Gus does exactly that.
